# SYNTHETIC test fixtures — not real project data

Every file in this folder is **synthetic**: invented people, companies, e-mail addresses and projects, created for testing. They are byte-identical copies of `sample_data/` taken on 2026-10-04 (backlog item BAS-02) so tests keep working after the legacy folders are removed (CLN-02).

Rules:

- **Never replace or add real project data here**, not even "just for a test". Real documents may contain confidential or personal information and this repository is intended to become public.
- New fixtures must be invented, or generated by a checked-in script in `tools/`, and listed in the table below with their SHA-256.
- Don't edit these files. Tests (including legacy golden comparisons, BAS-03) depend on their exact bytes. To change a fixture, add a new file instead.
